notes.title: The game is 1 year old!
notes.content:
Our game is a year old!
We are glad that you are with us, publish your feedback - we try to listen to them and make the game better!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30506928/9ff14b180113e31136dc2913004b16ed4cbfec79.jpg[/img]

Write more reviews - this is important to us and in this way we will make the game even more exciting!
This year there were more than 26 updates. You see how the game developed and new elements were added.

[h1] Here is a list of our work with you:[/h1]
- Added ability to skip game history
- Displays the duration of the effect on the right mouse button on the character
- Attacking the enemy from behind, doing more damage
- Enhanced spells "Berserk", "Explosion"
- Displays the maximum number of squad on the battlefield
- Survival mode with table of records
- Spell "Freeze" deals 4 times more damage to fire elementals
- Added necromancer to the final battle of the story campaign
- Added enemy heroes to "survival" mode
- Added hot keys (w - wait, d - protection, i - inventory, arrows - move the map, space - the next dialog)
- Added the achievement "John Wick"
- Updated main screen
- Displays the strike area of ​​the Tiger and Lizard
- Sorted units to king of the hill
- Spells are not active if they do not have enough mana.
- "Acceleration" is displayed on enemies
- Added osx version
- Increased difficulty level on difficult
- Added a tooltip in the army window at the experience of the unit
- Golem has freezing resistance, berserk
- Ice elementals and ents take double damage from fire elementals
- Added voice in comic
- Changed arena balance
- Redraw the entire game interface
- Added languages: Portuguese, Persian, French, Portuguese, Spanish
- Fixed many bugs

And much more

Thanks for the feedback!

Mac OS X: "% USERPROFILE% / AppData / Roaming / Greenolor Studio / NecromancerReturns / Documents / jox_bb2_01.dat"
